description: Percona Monitoring and Management: an open source database monitoring, observability and management tool
vibe: A tool-neutral, hierarchically organized source of truth that keeps AI agents on the rails without drowning them in context.
highlights: AGENTS.md is the single source of truth, with thin pointer files (CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, etc.) routing agents to it.
Component-specific guides are loaded on demand via nested CLAUDE.md imports, avoiding context bloat.
Global conventions are deliberately not repeated in component guides to prevent duplication and drift.
A curated 'PMM-specific choices' section repeats a handful of rules on purpose to catch common agent mistakes.
Clear decision trees for testing and linting ensure agents run the smallest relevant checks.
assessment: This document demonstrates exceptional engineering taste by treating AI agents as first-class contributors who need precise, non-redundant guidance. The hierarchical structure with on-demand loading is a clever solution to context window limitations, and the explicit anti-duplication rule shows a deep understanding of maintenance costs. The decision trees and 'Don'ts' list provide actionable constraints that prevent common pitfalls without being overly prescriptive.
